review_candidates.title: UN Women:Programme Specialist, Gender responsive Governance and Women’s Leadership, Jordan, NPSA10, Open to locals of Jordan Only
review_candidates.description: Job Description Background: UN Women, grounded in the vision of equality enshrined in the Charter of the United Nations, works for the elimination of discrimination against women and girls; the empowerment of women; and the achievement of equality between women and men as partners and beneficiaries of development, human rights, humanitarian action and peace and security. UN Women Jordan Country Office’s (JCO) work is carried out in support of the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan's Triple Modernization Agenda (the Political System Modernization, the Economic Modernization Vision and its Engendered Strategy, and the Public Sector Reform), the National Strategy for Women in Jordan (2020-2025), the second Jordanian National Action Plan for the Implementation of Security Council 1325 on Women, Peace and Security (2022-2025), the National Social Protection Strategy (2025-2033) and the Jordan Response Plan for the Syria Crisis, and is grounded in the principles and targets contained in the Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Discrimination Against Women (CEDAW), the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), and the Beijing Declaration and Platform for Action. UN Women JCO implements its triple mandate by working with the government of Jordan to strengthen national systems and to develop laws and policies to advance gender equality and women's empowerment; by working with the Government of Jordan, civil society and the private sector to support the implementation of international and national commitments to advance gender equality and women’s empowerment; and by strengthening coordination of the UN System and Development Partners in support of gender equality in Jordan. The Gender responsive Governance and Women’s Leadership Portfolio oversees the JCO work in support of the Political Modernization and the Public Sector Reform and encompasses overall technical support to the government of Jordan and its gender machinery on gender mainstreaming, as well as dedicated programmes focused on gender responsive budgeting, and women’s leadership and political participation in national and local governance system. The portfolio is implemented in close partnership with national partners including the Inter-Ministerial Committee for the Empowerment of Women (IMC), the Jordanian National Commission for Women (JCNW), the Ministry of Local Administration, the Ministry of Political and Parliamentary Affairs, the Independent Election Commission, the Ministry of Planning and International Cooperation as well as all the line ministries involved in the GRB programme, the General Budget Department, and civil society. Reporting to the Deputy Representative, the Programme Specialist exercises overall responsibility for planning, implementing, and managing UN Women interventions under their portfolio. The Programme Specialist supervises and leads the 6 staff members of the team. The Programme Specialist works in close collaboration with the programme and operations team, UN Women HQ and Regional Office staff, Government officials, multi and bi-lateral donors and civil society ensuring successful UN Women programme implementation under portfolio. Key Functions And Accountabilities Design and develop programme strategies in the area of Gender responsive Governance and Women’s Leadership Design and formulate programme/ project proposals and initiatives; Identify programmatic areas for support and interventions within the thematic/sectorial area of Gender responsive Governance and Women’s Leadership; Draft inputs to country strategy documents, briefs, policy dialogue and other documents related to Gender responsive Governance and WPP; Manage the implementation and management of the Gender responsive Governance and Women’s Leadership programme Finalize the annual workplan and budget and manage their implementation; Manage the technical implementation of the programme/project; ensure synergies with other teams; Manage the submission of implementing partner financial and narrative reports; Provide guidance to personnel and partners on Results Based Management tools and performance indicators; Organize Project Steering Committee, project review and/or evaluation meetings, as needed. Manage technical assistance and capacity development to project/programme partners Manage the implementation of technical advice and guidance. Develop and implement technical tools, and initiatives Build and manage relationships with national partners to support implementation and expansion of the Gender responsive Governance and Women’s Leadership programme; respond to any potential problems; Identify capacity building needs of partners and lead the coordination of technical assistance, mentoring, training and capacity development initiatives to partners. Manage the monitoring and reporting of the programme and projects Manage the monitoring of programme and projects implementation and finances using results based management tools; Oversee field missions and review reports on monitoring missions; Write quarterly reports and donor reports, focusing on results, output and outcomes for all projects under portfolio; Contribute to office-wide donor and UN Women reports. Manage the people and financial resources of the gender responsive Governance and Women’s Leadership programme Manage the programme and project budgets and draft financial reports; Supervise Programme Analysts, Associates and Technical Specialists and Consultants; Mentor and coach personnel and conduct performance assessments; Oversee recruitment processes, as necessary. Build partnerships and support in developing resource mobilization strategies Develop and implement partnerships and resource mobilization strategies; Finalize relevant documentation on donors and potential opportunities for resource mobilization; Analyze and research information on donors, prepare substantive briefs on possible areas of cooperation, identification of opportunities for cost sharing; Contribute to inter-agency coordination on Gender responsive Governance and Women’s Leadership to achieve coherence and alignment of UN Women programmes with other partners in the country Provide technical support to the Representative and Deputy Representative on inter-agency coordination related activities by attending meetings, events, and participating in groups and committees as needed; Coordinate with other UN agencies, government departments, donors and NGOs to ensure the projects’ capacity development programme is harmonized and aligned with other in-country efforts. Manage advocacy, knowledge building and communication efforts Support political scanning and the CO efforts to conduct substantive policy dialogue with Government counterparts, UN, and other development partners to facilitate the incorporation of UN Women programme priorities, CEDAW and the Beijing Platform for Action into national and sub-national plans and strategies, UN systems initiatives, and development frameworks; Organize periodic consultations with key stakeholders, women leaders, civil society organizations, human rights experts and UN partners to gather inputs on programme design, as necessary. Develop and review background documents, briefs and presentations related to Gender responsive Governance and Women’s Leadership; Represent UN Women in meetings and policy dialogues on issues related to Gender responsive Governance and Women’s Leadership as necessary; Develop advocacy strategies and oversee their implementation; Identify best practices and lessons learned to guide programme improvement and strategy planning; Develop knowledge management strategies, products and methodologies on [thematic area]. The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organization. Supervisory/Managerial Responsibilities The incumbent leads a team of 4 personnel. Competencies : Core Values: Integrity; Professionalism; Respect for Diversity. Core Competencies: Awareness and Sensitivity Regarding Gender Issues; Accountability; Creative Problem Solving; Effective Communication; Inclusive Collaboration; Stakeholder Engagement; Leading by Example. Please visit this link for more information on UN Women’s Values and Competencies Framework: Functional Competencies: Strong programme formulation, implementation, monitoring and evaluation skills Strong knowledge of Results Based Management Ability to synthesize programme performance data and produce analytical reports to inform management and strategic decision-making Strong Knowledge of women’s rights including CEDAW and the Beijing Platform for Action Strong knowledge of Gender responsive Governance and Women’s Leadership issues and programmatic strategies including gender mainstreaming and women’s political participation Solid knowledge of the Jordanian’s government reform efforts under the Triple Modernization Agenda Demonstrated network of connections with keys national stakeholders in the Women’s Empowerment ecosystem in Jordan including within government and political circles, civil society and with relevant international partners Strong political acumen Strong analytical skills Ability to identify and analyze trends, opportunities and threats to fundraising and develop strategies Recruitment Qualifications: Education and certification: Master’s degree or equivalent in social sciences, human rights, gender/women's studies, international development, or a related field is required A first-level university degree in combination with two additional years of qualifying experience may be accepted in lieu of the advanced university degree. A project/programme management certification would be an added advantage Experience: At least 5 years of progressively responsible work experience at the national or international level in design, planning, implementation, monitoring and evaluation of development projects in the field of gender equality and the empowerment of women is required. Demonstrated technical experience in gender responsive governance and women’s leadership is required. Experience in leading and coaching staff is required. Experience in coordinating and liaising at senior level with government agencies and donors is required. Experience in the usage of computers and office software packages (MS Word, Excel, etc.) and spreadsheet and database packages, experience in handling of web-based management systems is required. Experience working in the UN System is desirable. Experience in the use of a modern web-based ERP System, preferably Oracle Cloud, is desirable. Language Requirements: Fluency in English and Arabic is required. Statements : In July 2010, the United Nations General Assembly created UN Women, the United Nations Entity for Gender Equality and the Empowerment of Women. The creation of UN Women came about as part of the UN reform agenda, bringing together resources and mandates for greater impact. It merges and builds on the important work of four previously distinct parts of the UN system (DAW, OSAGI, INSTRAW and UNIFEM), which focused exclusively on gender equality and women's empowerment. Diversity and inclusion: At UN Women, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment of mutual respect. UN Women recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, ability, national origin, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, competence, integrity and organizational need. If you need any reasonable accommodation to support your participation in the recruitment and selection process, please include this information in your application. UN Women has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and UN Women, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and discrimination. All selected candidates will be expected to adhere to UN Women’s policies and procedures and the standards of conduct expected of UN Women personnel and will therefore undergo rigorous reference and background checks. (Background checks will include the verification of academic credential(s) and employment history. Selected candidates may be required to provide additional information to conduct a background check.) Note: Applicants must ensure that all sections of the application form, including the sections on education and employment history, are completed. If all sections are not completed the application may be disqualified from the recruitment and selection process .

review_candidates.title: Treasury Ops Specialist - Jumia (Full Time)
review_candidates.description: About Jumia : Jumia is a leading pan-African e-commerce platform. Its mission is to improve the quality of everyday life in Africa by leveraging technology to deliver innovative, convenient and affordable online services to customers, while helping businesses grow as they use Jumia's platform to better reach and serve customers. Jumia is built around a marketplace and supported by a proprietary logistics business [Jumia Logistics] and a digital payment and fintech platform [Jumia Pay] . With over 3,000 employees, Jumia is led by top talented leaders offering a great mix of local and international talents and is backed by very high-profile shareholders. Jumia is committed to creating a sustainable impact in Africa. In April 2019, Jumia was the first Tech company in Africa to be listed on the New York Stock Exchange. Why this role You will see the whole payment chain, from the request raised in an operating company to the cash leaving the bank, across all our African markets and the Group's central entities. Most treasury roles show you one link of that chain. This one shows you all of it. If that is the work you want to be doing, apply and le'stalk. What you will be doing: Payment execution: Suppliers, logistics partners and sellers across Africa get paid because you moved. Every working day you run the payment cycle for your countries: each request checked against its approval flow, executed through our in-house payouts module and the banking portals, and chased down when it fails. Cash control: You are the person who knows where the money is. Balances tracked across your markets, funding gaps spotted before anyone downstream feels them, and nothing leaving the bank that was not forecast. Financial control: Bank accounts and payee records are the front door of the company, and you hold the keys: bank master data, beneficiary details, changes to bank details, account openings and closures for your countries. Stakeholder communication: Local finance and operations teams, banks and payment providers all come to you. More than ten countries, several time zones, and no two banking relationships quite alike. Audit support: Jumia is listed in New York, so the cash you handle gets tested. At quarter and year end you build the evidence behind it, from bank confirmations and reconciliation inputs to SOX controls, and you are the one the auditors come to with their questions. Better ways of working: The job we hire you into should not be the job you are doing a year from now. We would rather kill a manual step than repeat it, through process, through our payment systems, or through the AI tooling we are rolling out across finance. What we are looking for Educational background: Degree in Accounting, Management, Finance, or equivalent training. Analytical prowess: You chase the number that does not tie until it explains itself. Control mindset: You notice the request that does not look right, and you say so. Precision: Payments are unforgiving. A wrong digit is somebody's missing money and your afternoon gone. Tech-savvy: You pick up a new system without hand-holding, you are at ease working with data, and you would rather automate a repetitive task than get good at repeating it. Adaptability: Legal entities across Africa, Europe and the UAE, each with its own banks, rules and rhythm. Communication: Fluent in English, written and spoken. French is a plus for our francophone markets. These skills are not mandatory, but will help you stand out Previous experience in treasury operations. You have pushed real payments through a banking portal or a payments platform. Exposure to African markets, foreign exchange restrictions or cash repatriation. Experience working with Citibank platforms, CitiDirect in particular. You have already put AI to work on part of your own job. We Offer : A unique experience in an entrepreneurial, yet structured environment A unique opportunity of having strong impact in building the African e-commerce sector The opportunity to become part of a highly professional and dynamic team An unparalleled personal and professional growth as our longer-term objective is to train the next generation of leaders Please ensure to only apply for jobs with Jumia through our official website. Jumia will never charge you a fee to apply for a job: be wary of websites that claim to help you apply for a Jumia job or that charge a fee to get you a job.

review_candidates.title: Senior Consolidation & Financial Reporting Specialist
review_candidates.description: En SUBSTRATE AI seguimos creciendo. Somos un grupo empresarial internacional especializado en Inteligencia Artificial, Datos e Infraestructura Tecnológica, formado por diferentes empresas con presencia internacional y un ambicioso plan de crecimiento basado en la innovación, la expansión y la constitución de nuevas empresas. Buscamos un Especialista Senior en Consolidación e Informes Financieros para fortalecer nuestro equipo financiero y impulsar la consolidación financiera del Grupo, la información corporativa y la mejora continua de nuestros procesos financieros. Si buscas una oportunidad emocionante y la posibilidad de formar parte de un entorno internacional, dinámico y en constante evolución, queremos conocerte. ¿Cuál será tu misión? Serás un actor clave en el área de finanzas corporativas, responsable del proceso de consolidación financiera del Grupo y asegurando la fiabilidad de la información económica y financiera. Trabajarás estrechamente con las distintas empresas nacionales e internacionales, participando también en proyectos estratégicos relacionados con el crecimiento y la evolución del Grupo. Principales responsabilidades • Ejecutar el proceso mensual, trimestral y anual de consolidación financiera del Grupo. • Preparar los estados financieros consolidados bajo la normativa IFRS y la información financiera a los mercados de capitales. • Coordinar y revisar la información financiera presentada por las distintas empresas nacionales e internacionales. • Gestionar eliminaciones intra-grupos, estandarización de criterios contables y ajustes de consolidación. • Analizar las principales variaciones financieras y empresariales, identificando riesgos y oportunidades de mejora. • Participar en la elaboración de informes financieros para la Dirección y el Consejo de Administración. • Apoyar el proceso de cierre contable de las distintas empresas del Grupo, teniendo en cuenta los distintos GAAP locales cuando sea necesario. • Colaborar en procesos de Due Diligence, adquisiciones, fusiones y reorganizaciones corporativas. • Definir, implementar y mantener políticas contables, procedimientos internos y controles financieros que garanticen la homogeneidad del Grupo. • Coordina la relación con auditores externos y asesores financieros. • Promover iniciativas de automatización y la mejora continua de los procesos de consolidación financiera y de reportes . • Preparar informes económicos-financieros y de gestión para la Dirección. ¿Qué buscamos? Formación • Licenciatura en Administración y Gestión de Empresas, Economía, Finanzas o titulaciones relacionadas. Experiencia • Mínimo entre 5 y 10 años de experiencia en Auditoría Externa (preferiblemente Big4) o en departamentos de Consolidación Financiera de grupos empresariales. • Experiencia demostrable en procesos de consolidación financiera y auditorías. • Sólido conocimiento de la normativa IFRS. • La experiencia en grupos internacionales y entornos multinacionales es muy valorada. • La experiencia en empresas cotizadas es muy valorada. Experiencia técnica • Consolidación financiera . • Preparación de estados financieros consolidados. • Norma IFRS. • Excel avanzado. • Dominio de herramientas digitales y ERP financiero. • La experiencia con Power BI, Power Query o herramientas similares de automatización y análisis de datos es una ventaja. Idiomas • Comunicación fluida y profesional en inglés , nivel B2 o superior, tanto oral como escrito. • Comunicación fluida y profesional en Español , tanto oral como escrito. Competencias Buscamos a una persona que destaque por: • Alta capacidad analítica. • Atención al detalle. • Pensamiento crítico . • Organización y planificación. • Autonomía y capacidad de decisión. • Orientado a resultados. • Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y coordinación con equipos internacionales. • Proactividad y orientación hacia la mejora continua. • Capacidad para funcionar en entornos dinámicos y en constante crecimiento. ¿Qué ofrecemos?  Oficinas en Valencia, con un modelo de trabajo híbrido.  Salario fijo entre 55.000 y 70.000 € brutos anuales, dependiendo de la experiencia, conocimientos técnicos y habilidades profesionales aportados por el candidato.  Contrato a tiempo completo e indefinido.  Incorporación a un grupo empresarial internacional en proceso de expansión.  Plan de carrera con posibilidades reales de crecimiento profesional.  Participación en proyectos estratégicos de alto impacto, colaboración con equipos nacionales e internacionales .  Excelente ambiente laboral, autonomía y participación activa en la evolución del ámbito financiero. ¿Estás interesado/a? Si quieres formar parte de un proyecto innovador y asumir un papel estratégico dentro del área financiera de un grupo empresarial internacional, estaremos encantados de conocerte. Solo se evaluarán las solicitudes que cumplan los requisitos del puesto.
